# get demo -> tbl_demographics
```{r}
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id,  race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```

# ATTEMPT TO COMPARE ENVIRONMENT TO VISITTYPE
```{r}
visitype <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  select(visit_id, visit_type)

environmen <- nlp_table %>% 
  select(visit_id, E_Environment) 

environmen <- data.frame(environmen) %>% 
  distinct(visit_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

```

```{r}
full_join(visitype,environmen,by=c('visit_id')) %>%
  mutate(need = case_when(is.na(visit_type) ~ 'only_visitype',

                          TRUE ~ 'duplicated')) %>%
